title: agentbay.config.yaml
description: Per-project user settings. modes.<name> is validated against that mode's config schema; connectors.<name> against the connector's config schema. Settings can only tighten mode constraints and env limits (strictest wins). Capabilities are bound only in envs/<env>.yaml; there is no config-level binding override.

agent.description: The agent profile (agents/<name>.yaml) that runs every role: how one LLM product maps tiers to models. Default: claude-code.

envs.description: Every role a mode runs in env A runs in env B instead: {A: B}. B must declare `substitutes: A`. Selects between tracked envs; it cannot bind capabilities.

workflows.description: Project workflows: ordered stages composing mode endpoints, run via cos.run. Stage kinds are `call` (<mode>.<endpoint>) and `gate` (approval). `with`, `when`, $in.<field> and $steps.<id>.<field> mean what they mean in a mode workflow. `bay lint` checks every target against the registry and every `with` against that endpoint's input schema.

in.description: JSON Schema for this workflow's own input, referenced as $in.<field>.

call.description: The endpoint this stage runs, as `bay call` spells it.

with.description: Input for the endpoint. $in.<field> and $steps.<id>.<field> are substituted; keys whose value is missing are dropped.

when.description: Skip the stage unless this value is truthy.

gate.description: Approval gate: the run stops and only `bay approve` passes it.
